write.bin/vibe:
#!/bin/sh
D="$HOME/calls"
C="$HOME/canned"
mkdir -p "$D"
case "$1" in
  login|auth) echo "status $*" >> "$D/vibe.txt"; echo "signed in with an api key"; exit 0 ;;
esac
n=0
[ -f "$D/vibe.n" ] && read n < "$D/vibe.n"
n=$((n + 1))
echo "$n" > "$D/vibe.n"
pick() { if [ -f "$C/vibe.$1.$n" ]; then echo "$C/vibe.$1.$n"; else echo "$C/vibe.$1"; fi; }
{
  echo "call $n"
  echo "cwd $(pwd -P)"
  for a in "$@"; do echo "arg $a"; done
  echo "env AGENT_KIT_DELEGATION=${AGENT_KIT_DELEGATION-<unset>}"
  echo "env MISTRAL_API_KEY=${MISTRAL_API_KEY-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_HOME=${VIBE_HOME-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_ENABLE_MCP=${VIBE_ENABLE_MCP-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_ENABLE_SUBAGENTS=${VIBE_ENABLE_SUBAGENTS-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_INCLUDE_PROJECT_CONTEXT=${VIBE_INCLUDE_PROJECT_CONTEXT-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_OUTSIDE_WORKDIR=${VIBE_OUTSIDE_WORKDIR-<unset>}"
  echo "env VIBE_MCP_SERVERS=${VIBE_MCP_SERVERS-<unset>}"
} >> "$D/vibe.txt"

prev=
for a in "$@"; do
  case "$prev" in
    --output-dir) outdir=$a ;;
    --usage-file) usage=$a ;;
  esac
  prev=$a
done
f=$(pick act)
[ -f "$f" ] && . "$f"
f=$(pick export)
if [ -n "$outdir" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then mkdir -p "$outdir"; cat "$f" > "$outdir/export.json"; fi
f=$(pick usage)
if [ -n "$usage" ] && [ -f "$f" ]; then cat "$f" > "$usage"; fi
f=$(pick sleep)
[ -f "$f" ] && exec sleep 30
f=$(pick out)
[ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f"
f=$(pick err)
[ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f" >&2
ex=0
f=$(pick exit)
[ -f "$f" ] && read ex < "$f"
exit "$ex"
